name: The Bait for Lar'korwi
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details: This will be the most difficult part because there is some complexity to the plan. To the north of here, you will find a small trail into the mountains. It was here I saw Lar'korwi last. You will know you are in the right area because of all the bones from massive creatures that once wandered nearby. Take the meat you recovered and place it there. Then, rub this mixture I created on the meat. If both lures mingled together do not bring Lar'korwi to you, then I know nothing else that will.
narrative.objectives: Using the contents of Torwa's Pouch, summon Lar'korwi and defeat him. Then bring Lar'korwi's Head to Torwa Pathfinder near the entrance to Un'Goro Crater.
narrative.offerRewardText:
The Earth Mother be praised! You've done it! Fair play to you, adventurer. You have proven to be a great Champion in your own right. Your spirit is strong. Your bravery unmatched. And your strength has been fortified. I bow down to your skills.

Only the greatest of my ancestors could have accomplished something so incredible. Congratulations.
narrative.requestItemsText:
Do not let fear overpower you, adventurer. Fear is the great betrayer... you must remain strong!

Take the meat, place it in the small valley, and then use the gland on it. Only then will death come for you.

chain.subtitle: 3 quests from level 53 to 56, 17,800 XP in all.

quests.name: The Fare of Lar'korwi
quests.objectiveText: Find the carcass of Lar'korwi's freshest kill and steal a Piece of Threshadon Carcass before returning to Torwa Pathfinder in Un'Goro Crater.

quests.name: The Scent of Lar'korwi
quests.objectiveText: Bring 2 Ravasaur Pheromone Glands to Torwa Pathfinder near the entrance to Un'Goro Crater.

quests.name: The Bait for Lar'korwi
quests.objectiveText: Using the contents of Torwa's Pouch, summon Lar'korwi and defeat him.
